field_survey_tripod.description: Holds a sighting target beside the field calibration pad.

steering_encoder_jig.description: Clamps a wheel in its channel. The spirit level on the bridge plate shows when the wheel sits square.

irrigation_junction.description: Valve manifold that splits the cistern's water into the plot's irrigation lines.

soil_moisture_probe.description: The plot's auto-irrigation waters by this dial.

harvest_crate.description: Picked crops wait here before they go to market.

env_chamber_cart.description: Climate test chamber on a wheeled cart.

ref_meter_ls85.description: Bench reference meter, resting on the chamber's lid.

mexican_redknee_tank.description: Brachypelma hamorii, in a small tank of its own: tarantulas don't share a tank.

brazilian_black_tank.description: Grammostola pulchra, in a small tank of its own: tarantulas don't share a tank.

fm3_field_meter_case.description: Handheld field meter in its open carry case on the bench mat.

chilled_mirror_hygrometer.description: Humidity reference: it cools a small mirror until dew forms on it and reads the dew point.

dry_well_calibrator.description: Temperature reference: a heated metal block with a well for the probe under test.

px1_rotary_table.description: Angle reference: it turns to set angles, and the steering encoder on the jig is checked against them.

silk_winding_spool.description: A hand-crank reel for winding optical silk.

terrarium_mister_kit.description: A mister bottle and feeding tongs on a tray.

md2p_humidity_generator.description: Humidity reference: it makes air at a set relative humidity for the hygrometer under test.

gulch_culvert_bridge.description: A plank deck over a corrugated culvert in the dry gulch.

plateau_weather_mast.description: Weather instruments on a pole: a louvered sensor shield on the mast and instruments on top.

solar_array_skid.description: A tilted solar array on a skid.

portable_core_drill.description: A portable core drill on legs.

ore_sorting_skip.description: A hopper bin on skids, heaped with plateau rock and quartz.

seismic_thumper.description: A hammer weight on guide rails.

rover_docking_pad.description: A parking pad with guide curbs and an umbilical socket at the rear.

twin_column_air_dryer.description: A compressor with two desiccant columns that dry its air.

mug_ring.description: A ring of dried coffee on the bench top. Somebody set a mug down here, and it was not you.
